title: Decode Zstandard HTTP responses
goal: Negotiate and decode Zstandard HTTP responses with cancellation and a decoded size budget; use when a server emits zstd, checking remaining stacked or unsupported encodings.

sdk.reason: Build net11.0 against .NET 11 references; exact SDK11 RC2 is a separate tested baseline.
sdk.name: .NET SDK

runtime.reason: The newer proxy spelling/automatic decoder requires the .NET 11 SocketsHttpHandler implementation.
runtime.name: .NET

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical net11.0 project explicitly selects C#15.0; the proxy/decompression API does not itself require new language syntax. This is the configured example route, not a minimum-language claim.

prerequisites: Nullable/implicit-usings net11.0 application; copy canonical types into the same assembly.
Server supplying supported HTTP content codings; caller-owned total cancellation and decoded-output budget.
platforms: SocketsHttpHandler on CoreCLR; Windows x64 executed, browser/mobile native handlers and other operating systems unverified.
providers: No external provider; runtime-supplied native compression codec.
stabilityLimitations: Actual RC2 verification, not final-GA proof; PIN-962 and PIN-959 remain open.
constraints: Only outermost supported coding is decoded; reject remaining unsupported/stacked encodings or decode them deliberately.
No .NET 10 framework backport; older manual ZstdSharp.Port 0.8.6 resolves lib/net9.0 and runs on real .NET 10.
64 KiB decoded budget does not bound all codec memory/CPU; caller owns deadlines and response disposal.

evidence.scope: Real Windows x64 HTTP/1.1 negotiation, zstd/gzip/deflate/br/identity body and headers, both stacked orders, unsupported/malformed encoding and stalled-body cancellation; manual .NET 10 decoder, bounded reader. No other native-handler/platform, hostile-codec resource guarantee or GA proof.
